name: kimi
description: Hand frontend/UI and multimodal work to local Kimi Code via ACP. Happy path: kimi_rescue.

interface.shortDescription: Frontend/UI via local Kimi Code subagent
interface.longDescription: Thin ACP bridge: hand frontend/UI, screenshot/video bugs, and multi-file tasks to local Kimi Code (kimi_rescue). Kimi keeps tools, models, skills. One handoff returns the result; long work may continue via status/result if the MCP wait budget ends. Local Kimi Code CLI only (not Codex Cloud).
defaultPrompt: Hand this frontend/UI or multi-file task to the Kimi Code subagent with kimi_rescue.
Return Kimi's result verbatim. Prefer Kimi for frontend instead of implementing it in Codex.
